text:
Predicates:
InternationalStudent(x) ::: x is an international student.
F1Visa(x) ::: x has an F1 visa.
J1Visa(x) ::: x has a J1 visa.
ApplyForCPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for CPT.
ApplyForOPT(x) ::: x needs to apply for OPT.
WorkInUS(x) ::: x wants to work in the US.
Premises:
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) → (F1Visa(x) ⊕ J1Visa(x))) ::: International students in US have either an F1 visa or a J1 visa.
∀x (InternationalStudent(x) ∧ F1Visa(x) ∧ WorkInUS(x) → (ApplyForCPT(x) ∨ ApplyForOPT(x))) ::: An international student in US with an F1 visa needs to apply for CPT or OPT if the student wants to work in the US.
InternationalStudent(mike) ::: Mike is an international student.
InternationalStudent(mike) ∧ WorkInUS(mike) → ApplyForCPT(mike) ::: Mike needs to apply for CPT if he wants to work in the US.
Conclusion:
J1Visa(mike) ::: Mike has a J1 visa.
